supersedes_amendment.why_amending_rather_than_re_preregisteri: The sota-v5 registry has published no rows and observed no v5 model data, so no outcome could have influenced any choice recorded here. Amending in place with a dated record keeps the lineage auditable; a silent overwrite would not.

selection_policy: Twelve of the sixteen identities are the frozen v6 panel from docs/bench_v6_spec.md unchanged. The 2026-09-01 amendment revises four rows after the smoke gate: two keep their identity on a new route, two are replaced. Replacement identities were chosen by the owner from public adoption and pricing metadata, never from any GM-Bench score or model output (see amendment.identity_revision_inputs). Routes are still picked per identity by the frozen route_selection_rule from free public catalog metadata, and every route still requires an authenticated zero-completion preflight and one separately authorized strict smoke.

route_selection_rule.hard_eligibility: Healthy exact route (catalog status 0) on the registered model identity, advertising max_tokens, reasoning, response_format and structured_outputs, with max_completion_tokens of at least 4,096, and publishing both uptime fields: 24-hour uptime of at least 99.0% and 30-minute uptime of at least 90.0%. The 30-minute floor is the one scripts/run_publication_matrix.py enforces at preflight, and it fails closed on a missing value, so a route that publishes no 30-minute figure is not eligible here either.
ordering: Prefer the least lossy advertised quantization available for that identity (unknown/bf16/fp16 over fp8/int8 over fp4/int4), because quantization changes the measured system.
Then the lowest planning cost at the committed 8,000-input / 4,096-output planning bound.
Then the highest 24-hour uptime, then the lexicographically smallest endpoint tag.
route_selection_rule.supersedes: The 2026-08-16 highest-24-hour-uptime route rule. That rule selected premium 'priority' and 'fast' service tiers that cost up to twice the standard tier for the same model identity and pushed the cap-priced panel from $109.51 to $162.84, with no measurement benefit.
route_selection_rule.price_is_not_an_outcome_input: Route price is a property of the endpoint, not of any observed result. Using it to order routes within an already-frozen model identity cannot make the selection outcome-dependent; using it to choose which model identities run still cannot happen, and the panel identities were frozen in the v6 spec.
route_selection_rule.lane_infrastructure_exclusion: Added 2026-09-01. A route that reached the lane's frozen two-attempt infrastructure limit, as recorded in the run-directory reservation ledger, is ineligible for re-registration under any model identity; the ordering then re-applies to the remaining eligible routes. Cloudflare (z-ai/glm-5.3-flash) and Parasail (minimax/minimax-m3, qwen/qwen3.5-397b-a17b) are excluded on this basis; both would otherwise be the mechanical winners.

reasoning_policy_rule.rule: Per model, not per lane. Where the public catalog reports reasoning.mandatory=false, pin the advertised disabled path (OPENROUTER_REASONING_ENABLED=false) and leave OPENROUTER_REASONING_EFFORT absent. Where it reports reasoning.mandatory=true, run at the lowest advertised supported effort and record the reasoning tokens beside the score.
reasoning_policy_rule.output_ceiling_interaction: The 4,096-token ceiling includes reasoning tokens. For a mandatory-reasoning row, minimum-effort reasoning is billed inside that ceiling, so whether a full action list still fits is a smoke-time question that free metadata cannot answer.

reasoning_policy_rule.supersedes: The 2026-08-16 lane-wide 'disabled' policy whose mandatory_reasoning_action aborted the lane. The v6 execution rules keep mandatory-reasoning models in the panel at minimum effort instead.

ascending_cost_run_order.basis: Ascending planning panel cost from results/analysis/sota-v6-panel-cost-estimate.json (29 seeds x 5 seasons x 4 phases = 580 paid calls per model at 8,000 input and 4,096 output tokens). Running the cheap rows first means a route, render, or repair problem surfaces on the cheapest cells, and the two most expensive rows (x-ai/grok-4.6 at $23.53 and anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5 at $16.52) are the last money committed.

superseded_acceptance.retired_because: It accepted the sixteen routes registered by the 2026-09-01 route-and-cohort amendment with z-ai/glm-5.3-flash on Fireworks. The owner moved that row to DeepInfra fp8 the same day (amendment addendum), so the acceptance was regenerated. The evidence artifact is kept unedited under the dated name.

It accepted the sixteen routes registered by the 2026-08-31 amendment. Four of those routes were withdrawn by the 2026-09-01 route-and-cohort amendment (Cloudflare for z-ai/glm-5.3-flash, Parasail for minimax/minimax-m3 and qwen/qwen3.5-397b-a17b, Crusoe for nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b), so the whole acceptance was regenerated rather than patched. The twelve unchanged routes were re-verified in the new acceptance. The evidence artifact is kept unedited under the dated name.

It accepted eight routes for the withdrawn 2026-08-16 cohort under contract fingerprint 247e12fe5a7d4f5b. None of those routes is registered here and the fingerprint has moved, so the acceptance is retired rather than carried forward. The evidence artifact is kept unedited as history.

public_metadata_limitations: Every route, price, uptime and reasoning value here was read from the free unauthenticated OpenRouter model and endpoint listings on 2026-08-31. Unauthenticated metadata does not establish account access, privacy terms, successful inference, reasoning behaviour, JSON behaviour, request-cap behaviour, or authoritative per-call cost.

moonshotai/kimi-k2.5 has exactly one eligible route above the 99% uptime floor and it is int4-quantized. That is a measurement caveat for this row, not a route failure; record the quantization beside the score.

google/gemini-3.7-flash and google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite are pinned to Google AI Studio 'flex' service tiers, which trade queueing latency for price. Latency is reported, not scored, but confirm the tier answers at all during the smoke.

The four mandatory-reasoning rows (grok-4.6, gemini-3.7-flash, glm-5.3-flash, gpt-oss-20b) spend part of the 4,096-token ceiling on reasoning. Whether a full action list still fits is unverifiable from metadata and is marked verify-at-smoke-time per row.
Prices are volatile point-in-time values and must be rechecked immediately before any spend decision.
